name: SVC_FS_TECH_PREFERENCES
description: This table is used to define the technician preferences for a customer site which identifies if a specific technician is either required, preferred or forbidden from being on a specific customer site. TECHNICIAN_PREF_ID is the primary / unique key in this table.

columns.name: TECHNICIAN_PREF_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: SERVICE_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key referencing SVC_SERVICE_PROFILES (SERVICE_PROFILE_ID), the Service Profile for this technician preference.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key referencing HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID), the Account for this technician preference.

columns.name: TECHNICIAN_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key referencing HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID), the Technician for this technician preference.

columns.name: TECHNICIAN_PREFERENCE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the type of technician preference, such as Preferred, Required or Forbidden.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to identify if a specific technician preference is active.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
